summary: The implementation rejected valid mixed-type TOML arrays. The fix removes the homogeneous-type check and associated fallible array APIs. Blocked: a compiling verbatim reversal requires coordinated changes across src/value.rs, src/parser/array.rs, and src/parser/errors.rs, which this single-file reversal schema cannot express. Restoring only the parser references removed methods and an error variant; restoring value.rs makes the unchanged parser loop return Result instead of (). Regression coverage enabled by the fix resides in the custom decoder_compliance harness, not a source-defined Rust test with an established full test name. The ordinary array tests inspected do not exercise mixed element types. No builds or tests were run.
